# Upstream linear-cli's command surface, pinned - the input to tests/upstream_parity.rs.
#
# Source:  https://github.com/schpet/linear-cli @ d4fe6fa7358f018fd1da0c6b96ec2b022247e898 (2026-09-22)
# Format:  one command path per line, then one line per long flag of that command
#          (`<path> --flag`). Lines beginning with `#` are comments.
# Refresh: clone upstream, regenerate, review the diff -
#            git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/schpet/linear-cli /tmp/upstream-lcl
#            python3 /opt/data/.tmp-lin/gen-upstream-surface.py /tmp/upstream-lcl/src
#          The generator is deliberately kept out of this repository (it reads another
#          repository); the recipe above and the notes below are what make it reproducible.
#
# What the generator cannot see, and why this is a reviewed fixture rather than a proof:
#   * a command built inline (`new Command()` in its parent's chain) contributes its path but not
#     its flags;
#   * an identifier is resolved within the file that declares it, because upstream reuses names
#     (`listCommand` exists in several groups) - the first run of the generator attributed
#     `project`'s `--project` to `auth list`, which is a good example of what reviewing catches;
#   * `.option()` calls chained after a `.command(…)` group belong to the parent in cliffy's model,
#     which is how upstream declares its own group-level flags.
#
# A change to this file is a decision about what "parity" means; it is meant to show up as a diff.
